这是一个游戏宣传pv封面，要求有科技感，主色调为蓝色和白色，其余你站在专业封面设计大师角度，背景更加好看，有属于人物的能量条，体力值，爆气条。不要有按钮；其余你自由排版和发挥。
不要有过度的细碎模块重复的伪高细节。专业海报pv构图，酷炫毛笔艺术文字，该简约的地方要简约。一切不需要细节的地方，都不要细节化处理。

参考图1只参考剑和持剑姿势，图2人脸外观，图3服装，保证最上面八分之一和最下面五分之一没有文字。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] At 0.00 seconds, The video begins with a 0.05‑second black screen，then the video opens on the exact composition of <Picture 1>, with <Picture 2> used only as an identity reference for the same girl's face, hair, ornaments, and proportions. She remains on the right side of the frame with the raised sword, the large title "未来剑姬" stays centered-left, and the lower gauges "ENERGY", "STAMINA", and "BURST" remain visible. A single black-frame flicker interrupts the opening immediately after the first visual beat, then the same composition snaps back as thin blue shards and streaks pull toward the blade. [Shot 2] At 00:01.200, the camera pushes in toward her eyes and lifted sword hand; she tightens her grip, the blue ribbons and particles compress around the blade, the "ENERGY" and "BURST" bars surge brighter, and a small "READY" tag slams in beside the hilt before breaking apart. Her expression hardens into a stern, dangerous smile. [Shot 3] At 00:03.600, she whips the sword in a fast diagonal slash; the camera whip-pans with the arc, the blue trail detonates into a white-blue full-screen shock, and the title letters split into flying fragments as the cut lands with a sharp metal ring and a crushing impact. [Shot 4] At 00:06.400, the shockwave flips from blue to molten gold around her full body; the camera pulls back to a wider hero view, her hair and ribbons stream outward, the gold aura wraps her silhouette, and the bars slam to full as the face stays stern with a faint predatory smile. [Shot 5] At 00:11.000, the aura collapses into a controlled gold rim light as she lowers the blade and returns to a composed finishing stance; the title "未来剑姬" reassembles cleanly, the gauges stabilize at "100%", and the final lock-off holds on her calm, lethal expression for the last beat.

overall_soundscape: Wind rushes through the opening, followed by tight cloth snaps, a clean sword ring, and a rising crystalline energy crackle. The slash lands with a heavy low boom and a burst of sharp debris-like shivers, then the final seconds settle into a thin electrical hiss and quiet air pressure.

non_diegetic_music: 150 BPM hybrid trailer track in 4/4 with staccato synth plucks, taiko-like low drums, snare builds, and bright metallic accents. The blackout flicker lands on a muted downbeat, the first slash hits the main drop, and the ending cuts short on a clean sustain instead of a long outro.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] <Picture 1> holds as the first frame. At 0.00 seconds, The video begins with a 0.05‑second black screen,then A young woman stands centered on a sunlit tropical beach in a medium shot, facing the camera. She has long black hair with blue inner strands and blue tips, blue eyes, a closed-mouth smile, a blue hairband with white ornaments, a white-and-blue floral hair piece on the left side of her head, and a dangling earring. She wears a white ruffled bikini top with thin blue halter straps and a large blue bow at the center of her chest, and a short white ruffled wrap over white bikini bottoms with blue bows at both hips. Her left hand rests near her left thigh. Turquoise ocean and white foam sit to the left; pale sand, palm trees, and distant green hills sit to the right under a deep blue sky with white clouds. The camera is the viewer’s first-person standing viewpoint at eye level. She takes one small step forward through the sand toward the viewer, and the camera push in at slow speed toward her face while wind carries her hair to the right of the frame and stirs the ruffles. [Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the first-person camera arrives in a close view of her full face, keeping her blue eyes, smile, hairband, floral hair piece, earring, and black-to-blue hair unchanged. She holds the viewer’s gaze, then tilts her head slightly to her right as the smile deepens and strands of hair drift across her cheek. [Shot 3] At 00:07.500, the first-person camera tilts down at slow speed along her neck and collarbones onto the large blue bow and the cleavage of the white ruffled bikini top. She draws a slow breath that lifts her chest; the bow and ruffles shift with the motion while the fabric stays in place. [Shot 4] At 00:10.000, she turns her body to her left, away from the viewer, and her long hair sweeps across her back. The first-person camera arc shot to the right at medium speed around her, dropping to waist-and-hip height and following the turn. [Shot 5] At 00:12.500, the first-person camera settles behind her on her back, waist, hips, and buttocks, with the white bikini bottom and ruffled wrap continuous from the opening outfit and the blue bows visible at both hips. Wind lifts the rear ruffles and shows the shape of her buttocks in the bikini without removing the clothing. She looks back over her left shoulder and locks eyes with the first-person camera as the ocean and palms hold the background.

overall_soundscape: Ocean waves break on the sand throughout. One soft footstep lands in the sand as she steps forward. Light fabric rustle and hair in the wind continue under the camera move. A quiet inhale is heard when the camera reaches her chest.

non_diegetic_music: A 96 BPM 4/4 bed of muted kick, filtered bass, and clean electric guitar stays sparse through the approach and the face close-up. The bass filter opens on the tilt onto the blue bow at 00:07.500. A snare-and-cymbal downbeat hits as she turns at 00:10.000, and a final sustained guitar chord with one low kick lands as she looks back over her shoulder.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] The frame opens on the exact reference pose, outfit, sword, and gray backdrop. At 00:00.050, the image snaps to black for a single beat, then the same warrior reappears in the same stance inside a dense, pitch-dark forest clearing as wet leaves, trunks, and thin mist become visible around him. From the treeline, a group of masked swordmen rushes in from both sides, their blades catching tiny glints as they close the gap. [Shot 2] At 00:02.400, the camera pushes in from a three-quarter front angle as the first attacker swings down from the left; the warrior tilts his shoulders, slides a half-step off the line, and lets the strike pass through the empty space where his chest was a moment before. Two more blades follow in slowed motion, and he pivots between them with a narrow waist turn, cloak trailing behind him while sparks skim past the hem. [Shot 3] At 00:05.200, he drives off the ground into a clean upward leap, the camera tilting up with him as his sword arm rises and his cloak fans wide. In midair he draws the blade through a vertical arc, and dozens of glowing sword sigils assemble around the arc like a tight halo, locking the attackers below into his target line. [Shot 4] At 00:08.000, he releases the sword formula downward: spectral blades split from the halo in a burst and spear through the enemy formation, pinning some to tree trunks and smashing others back across the clearing. The ground fractures in a chain reaction, dirt columns and firebursts erupt outward, and the forest floor caves in around the impact path. [Shot 5] At 00:11.600, the debris rain slows as he lands in a low crouch amid the fading blast, then rises with the sword lowered and turns away without looking back. The camera follows from behind as he walks out through smoke and drifting embers, leaving a blasted corridor of broken trees and settling dust behind him until the final frame holds on his retreating silhouette.

overall_soundscape: Wet leaves crunch under rapid footsteps, branches snap, steel rings against steel, and short gusts of displaced air cut through the fight. As the sword rain lands, the ground cracks with repeated concussive booms, dirt and wood debris hammer back to earth, and the forest gradually falls into a smoky hush behind his departing steps.

non_diegetic_music: 148 BPM, 4/4. Low taiko pulses, tremolo strings, and sub-bass build under the opening beat, then the snare and brass tighten as the attackers rush in. A hard drop lands at 00:08.000 with the aerial sword release, then the percussion thins into a rolling tom pattern and a long string tail for the walk-off ending.
